labels.gold_reason: All scoped behavior and required verification are present with no contradictory evidence.
Compatibility, preservation, and round-trip behavior are all directly supported.
A required deterministic suite fails repeatedly because a generated artifact is stale.
The change violates the explicit read-only ownership boundary despite green local tests.
Receipt lineage is broken and an ambiguous effect can be repeated, violating exactly-once recovery.
Prefix authorization permits an unreviewed composed command and therefore weakens deny-by-default policy.
Two explicitly required downstream verification gates were not run and have no receipts.
The issue and repository policy conflict, and the evidence contains no authoritative decision resolving them.
